case_title: L. Krishna Reddy v. State by Station House Officer & Ors.
trial_court_outcome: Proceedings continued against accused Nos. 2 and 3
neutral_facts: The deceased couple, who had set up their own separate residence, were found to have been living independently of their in-laws. The deceased woman was found murdered in a hotel room in Pondicherry with multiple stab wounds. A charge sheet was filed under Sections 302 and 498-A of the IPC, alleging that the husband, along with his parents-in-law, had subjected the deceased to dowry harassment and caused her death. The husband committed suicide shortly after, leading to the abatement of charges against him. The parents-in-law were implicated based on statements under Section 161 Cr.P.C., but the prosecution could not establish a direct involvement or common intention. The High Court discharged the parents-in-law as there was no sufficient evidence to link them to the crime.
